title: L4 Application Brief Output
description: The application brief, and the wireframe-design-review input (design use) made from it, which stage 8a takes unchanged.

questions.description: The numbered questions put to the requester, verbatim.

applicationBrief.title: Application brief
applicationBrief.description: What the consuming application is, in the requester's words where they gave any. Defined by the l4-application-brief output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

topic.description: Kebab-case name of the application, used as the wireframe topic.

kind.description: The option chosen: a point-of-care app, a reporting or indicator dashboard, a decision-support service an EMR calls, or something else.

users.description: The L2 persona ids who use it.

l2Processes.description: The L2 business-process ids it covers.

l3Resources.description: Canonicals of the L3 resources it reads or writes.

operations.description: FHIR operations it calls: $apply, $evaluate-measure, CDS Hooks services.

systems.description: The systems it talks to: an EMR, a registry, a reporting server.

wireframeRequest.title: Wireframe request
wireframeRequest.description: The input cat-harness wireframe-design-review takes, filled for design use. The fields are that contract's (use, topic, surface, intent, humanReviewer, branch), so stage 8a is called with it unchanged. Defined by the l4-application-brief output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

intent.description: Who the screens are for, what they need to do, and what they must show, from the brief.

humanReviewer.description: Who chooses between candidates: the requester, by GitHub handle.

branch.description: The feature branch the candidates are committed on.

stagingLinks.title: Staging links
stagingLinks.description: The staging preview of the work a request for feedback is about: one deep link per changed page (the page and the anchor where the change sits) with the same page on main as `before`. Mirrors StagingComparison in schemas/staging.ts. The rule is skills/sdlc/sdlc-core/staging-review.md §"The deep-link rule". Copied inline as `definitions.stagingLinks` into every skill contract that carries it; schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.

slug.description: Branch slug used in the staging URL path.

pages.description: One entry per changed page, deep-linked; from the change's rendered-impact list, never chosen by judgement.

before.description: Same page on main; absent for a new page.

after.description: The page on the staging preview, with the anchor where the change sits; absent for a deleted page.

summary.description: What to look at on this page.

missing.description: What could not be linked, said rather than hidden: no preview yet (and when it will exist), no page list computed, or a changed page the publish ref does not hold.

stagingLinks.$comment: Copy of cat-harness schemas/staging-comparison.schema.json; cat-harness schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.
